main_text.l: 3. Illius vero intuitu contemnamus ac rejiciamus qualiacunque contraria dogmata, ratiocinationes, & revelationes: Matth.xv, 6, 9. 2 Cor.x, 5. Col. ii, 8, Luc.xvi, 29, 31. Gal. i, 8, -12.

4. Grato animo agnoscamus instructissimum illum salutis thesaurum, apothecam locupletissimam, donum perfectissimum: Psal.cxix, 96. religiosè observantes istam αὐτάρκειαν; intra illas lineas continentes nos ipsos, & ad easdem revocantes alios, quantum in nobis: Col. iii, 16. Phil. iii, 16. 1 Joh. 1. 3, 4.

5. Istâ luce nos oblectemus, in eâ ambulemus, donec merus dies illucescat: 2 Petr. i, 19. cum Joh. v, 35. viii, 56. Psal.xxxv i, 9, 10. xix, 12. cxix, 103. In obscuris & dubiis huc confugiamus: Psal.cxix, 98, 99, 100. 104, 105. Actor. xvii, 11. 2 Tim. iii. 15, 16. Hoc pio studio peregrinationem nostram consolemur, Psal. cxix, 25, 28, 50, -56. Rom.xv, 4.

6. Sic rationem nostram moderemur, atque in SS. Literis nos pie exerceamus, ut genuinum sensum assequamur: 1 Cor.x, 15. Matth.xvi, 24. xi, 25, 26, 27. xiii, ii, -1 Cor.xiv, 9, 12, 20. Præ aliis autem hoc agant Antecessores: 2 Tim. iii, 17. Ii, 15. i, iv, 16. Tit. i, 9, 10, 11. Quæ vero recte percepta sunt, teneamus constanter: Apoc. iii, 3, 11. in opera convertamus: Joh.xiii, 17. & ad aliorum ædificationem pro virili nostra conferamus: 1 Thes.v, 11.
